summary: Frontend-only validation of the payment-deadline warning banner added on OrderConfirmation.jsx. End-to-end guest checkout via UI for both Interac and NOWPayments/BTC, plus MongoDB payment_status flips to 'paid' and 'cancelled' to verify banner visibility rules. Full regression on Interac instructions block and order totals. All 4 requested scenarios pass.
tests_executed: Interac guest checkout end-to-end (QC address, 3 compliance ticks) -> lands on /order/:id
Banner data-testid='payment-deadline-warning' visible with EN heading 'Payment required within 48 hours' and body 'automatically cancelled'
Language toggle -> banner renders FR heading 'Paiement requis sous 48 heures' and body containing 'annulée'
Regression: data-testid='interac-instructions' present with all copyable rows (interac-email, interac-amount, interac-ref, interac-question, interac-answer)
Regression: order total = $84.99 CAD ($64.99 subtotal + $20 shipping — subtotal < $200)
Crypto (NOWPayments mock, BTC) guest checkout -> banner visible on order with payment_status=awaiting_crypto; data-testid='crypto-instructions' rendered with DEMO MODE notice
Mongo flip payment_status='paid' + reload -> banner correctly hidden (count=0)
Mongo flip payment_status='cancelled' + reload -> banner correctly hidden (count=0)
Direct API check GET /api/orders/:id returns updated payment_status after mongo flip
critical_code_review_comments: OrderConfirmation.jsx: The order state is only refetched when `!order` (useEffect line 15-19). If a user is already on /order/:id and payment_status changes server-side, the banner won't hide until a hard reload. Not a bug for the current requirement (reload path works), but consider a periodic refetch or SSE for awaiting orders.

Console shows a React hydration warning '<span> cannot be a child of <option>' on the Checkout province <select>. This appears to be caused by Emergent devtool instrumentation wrapping option children — safe to ignore in dev, but worth confirming it doesn't leak to prod.
Some GETs to /api/auth/me return 401 on public pages (guest browsing). Harmless but generates console noise; consider suppressing for unauthenticated users.
test_credentials: Guest checkout — no credentials required. Admin creds available at /app/memory/test_credentials.md but not used.
seed_data_creation: Created 3 test orders during flow validation (all with email test_banner@example.com). All deleted at end. A pre-existing order (id=8bf21d40-...) was reused for the paid/cancelled flip test and restored to payment_status='awaiting_etransfer' after the test — NOT deleted.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Banner logic is `awaitingPayment = ['awaiting_etransfer','awaiting_crypto'].includes(order.payment_status)` on OrderConfirmation.jsx line 60. EN/FR strings inline in same file (lines 89-96). Language state persists in localStorage across navigation — reset via localStorage.clear() at test start to avoid FR carry-over between test cases. Note: `page.goto` to the same /order/:id does NOT force a re-fetch (React state persists); use `page.reload()` to force fresh GET when validating banner visibility after mongo flips.
rca of the issue: Original user complaint: no warning on order confirmation for pending payments. Fix (verified): OrderConfirmation.jsx now renders a red-bordered warning banner (data-testid='payment-deadline-warning') whenever payment_status is in ['awaiting_etransfer','awaiting_crypto'], with bilingual text and 48h deadline messaging. Verified end-to-end via UI for both Interac and crypto paths, and both positive/negative cases (paid, cancelled).
